abstract: The main findings of the comparison are as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
conclusion: Taken together, the arms compare as follows. Overall, Alvenor improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Alvenor and Standard care reach about the same side effects. Overall, Cardivel improves blood pressure control compared with Standard care. Overall, Cardivel reduces side effects compared with Standard care.
section:
### A further comparison between arms

Standard care is the usual blood pressure treatment given to every patient. Alvenor is a once daily tablet that relaxes the walls of the blood vessels. Cardivel is a tablet that slows the heart so it pushes with less force. The groups in this comparison were followed at the Northgate Heart Cohort.
